# New Default V2

Spawnpoint bundles the `Betapack_V2.zip` preservation port as a gzip-compressed USTAR archive. The browser expands it into Eaglercraft's normal resource-pack filesystem, so it appears in Minecraft's Resource Packs menu.

- Source: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/classic-jappa-new-default-v2-v1
- Source file: `Betapack_V2.zip`, CurseForge file 7830421
- Source SHA-256: `894c1cbb31cadf55b5326c6b661e150ef238d7fa0a9b15a8909854a6cc067a23`
- Bundled archive: `public/game/resource-packs/new-default-v2.tar.gz`
- Bundled SHA-256: `36a9184a4ee864cdbd29ed6e533ad1883c8b2809457636b81f02e3b066e72b72`
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0

Mojang Studios and Jasper Boerstra created the original artwork. Lissten preserved and ported this specific pack for Minecraft 1.12.2. The original `README.md` stays inside the bundled archive.

Spawnpoint overlays the seven supplied `pack.png PwS [1.11-1.12.2]` title panorama files. The six cube faces are 1080 by 1080 pixels, and `panorama_overlay.png` is the matching menu overlay.
